title: LinesResponse
description: Lines of a file with the deterministic gutter facts for them.

to.description: Last returned line (clamped to the file).

total_lines.description: Lines in the file on that side (0 for an emptied file).

changed.description:
Changed lines in the range (neutral gutter mark): added lines on the head side, removed lines on the
base side; Rust lines whose only change is whitespace are left out (they read as unchanged code).

context_only.description:
Changed Rust comment and plain import lines a deterministic line rule covers: the main view may hide them,
the classic diff always shows them.

deleted.description: Code removed by the pull request at markers in the range (head side only).

moved.description: Moved blocks in the range (head side only).

comments.description: Whether and how these lines can be commented on (deterministic, ADR-006).

LineSide.description:
Commit a line number refers to. Head is the common case (final code); base only for code that no longer
exists at the head commit (a deleted file, an emptied file, removed lines without a head line to anchor to).

oneOf.description: Lines of the base commit (removed code).

DeletedBlock.description: Removed code shown at its deletion marker.

after_line.description: Head line after which the code was removed; 0 = before the first line.

base_start.description: First removed line at the base commit.

lines.description:
Removed lines, from `base_start` on; fewer than `total_lines` when the response's line budget ran out
(read the rest with `side=base`).

total_lines.description: Number of removed lines in the block.

replacement.description: Head range paired with these old lines; absent for pure deletions.

context_only.description:
Removed Rust comment and plain import lines of the block a deterministic line rule covers: the main view may
hide them.

LineRange.description: Lines `start_line..=end_line`, 1-based, on the side given by the enclosing type.

MovedLines.description: A moved block in the range.

differing.description: Lines that differ from the original (`≠`).

CommentScope.description: Commenting on displayed lines, decided by the server from the pull request diff (ADR-006).

oneOf.description:
The file is in the pull request diff. Lines inside `line_thread_ranges` (and removed lines at markers)
get a line thread; other lines get a file-level thread whose body ends with the permalink.

line_thread_ranges.description: Ranges, on the response's side, whose lines get a line thread.

oneOf.description:
The file is not in the pull request diff: commenting is not available in v1; the UI offers the
permalink to copy.
